name: Invoice Owl
title: Invoicing and estimating software for contractors and small businesses
role: Developer: invoicing and P&L dashboard with interactive Chart.js revenue and overdue-invoice metrics
summary: InvoiceOwl helps contractors and small businesses send estimates and invoices, take payments online and see how the business is doing. I built its invoicing and P&L dashboard: interactive Chart.js views of revenue and overdue invoices, fed by the REST API.
problem: Tradespeople were juggling estimates, invoices, payments and client records across separate tools. InvoiceOwl puts them in one place: an approved estimate becomes an invoice, invoices go out with reminders, and reports show how the business is performing.

constraints.label: API-driven UI
constraints.text: Dashboards and reports read their data from the product's REST API.

constraints.label: Multi-platform
constraints.text: The same account is used on the web app and the iOS and Android apps.

architecture.caption: Estimate to invoice to payment, with reports and charts showing the business's performance.

sections.heading: What the product covers
paras: Estimates, invoices, card and ACH payments, credit memos, purchase orders, e-signatures, client management, review collection, real-time notifications when documents are opened, QuickBooks Online sync and reports, for up to 5 businesses from one account.

outcome: InvoiceOwl runs as a web app with iOS and Android apps. The dashboard shows revenue, profit and loss and overdue invoices as interactive Chart.js charts, read straight from the REST API.
